summary: feat(anylist): add barcode metadata, harden dogfood, and enforce Go 1.26.6
reason: AnyList exposes barcode-first product lookup and structured ListItem metadata, while dogfood exposed cache, JSON, search, help, and dry-run edge cases. Preserve both behaviors across reprints so agents can resolve products and rely on deterministic automation output. Keep the generated module and user-facing install guidance on the repository's current Go 1.26.6 security floor.
validated_outcome: Barcode lookup returned a real AnyList protobuf product for UPC 049000028904, including canonical name, package size, UPC, and thumbnail URL; dogfood completed 171/171 checks; focused and full Go tests passed; the module is aligned with the repository's Go 1.26.6 security floor.
